name: Rhett Caan
body: ## Summary This release disables the scheduled Gloas fork on Hoodi. All Hoodi users must upgrade to v8.3.2 before 26 October 2026 at 17:42:48 UTC, the previously scheduled activation time (epoch 132352). Staking users must update their beacon node, validator client and execution client. This supersedes the Hoodi fork instructions in the v8.3.0 and v8.3.1 release notes. Mainnet users do not need to upgrade. If you are upgrading from v8.2.x or earlier, please also read the [v8.3.0 upgrade notes](https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/releases/tag/v8.3.0) for database migration and system requirements. ## Update Priority This table provides priorities for which classes of users should update particular components. | User Class | Beacon Node | Validator Client | |:---|:---|:---| | Staking Users (Hoodi) | **High** | **High** | | Non-Staking Users (Hoodi) | **High** | --- | | Staking Users (mainnet & other networks) | Not required | Not required | | Non-Staking Users (mainnet & other networks) | Not required | --- | See [Update Priorities](https://lighthouse-book.sigmaprime.io/installation_priorities.html) for more information about this table. ## All Changes -
